summary: Dashboard app with fasting tracking features. User requested removal of 'Heute', 'Diese Woche', and 'Aktuelle Serie' from the Fasten (Fasting) Auswertung (evaluation) section of the dashboard.

existing_features.title: In the IntermittentFastingPanel component, remove the three evaluation/metrics display items: 'Heute' (Today), 'Diese Woche' (This Week), and 'Aktuelle Serie' (Current Streak) from the fasting summary/evaluation section. The rest of the panel (live countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase indicator, and FastingScheduleSettings) must remain intact.
